articles.title: Beaded Lightning

Up close: Rows of tiny cream-white elongated beads, 5 to 8 px, strung along wavy lines running lower-left to upper-right, each with a dark dash beside it. They sit on a cloudy ground of plum, mauve and dusty pink that swings between dark indigo and pale blush patches 80 to 150 px across. From a distance: Reads as a mottled plum-and-blush surface with a fine ripple like wind-blown sand or fish roe; the beads fade to a fine shimmer and the cloud patches carry the look.
